title: GATEWAY
body:
Please have your keycard, your papers and your
remaining dignity ready for inspection. Three walls,
three locked doors, a Warden on every patrol. Wardens
call the guards the moment they spot you, and they
will spot you. They also carry the keycards -- they
won't be needing them. Missile Batteries can't be
reached, only reasoned with. Reason loudly.

captions.text: Calls the guards. Has your keys.
Seekers. Stun it, then shoot it.
